contract.validity: Finite samples, exact expected shape, image uint8 range or nonnegative integer counts, label/gene alignment.

distribution_fidelity.image: Mean marginal Wasserstein distance in training-fitted standardized 4x4 pooled pixel/channel-variation features; includes per-class checks when labels exist. Not FID or a biological/perceptual score.
distribution_fidelity.counts: Mean absolute differences in log1p gene means, log1p gene variances, zero fractions, log1p panel-total Wasserstein distance, and correlations among up to 64 training-variable genes.
distribution_fidelity.reference: Equal-sized training resampling and held-out real observations, ten fixed-seed reference draws; report median and reference range, not a confidence interval.
distribution_fidelity.screen: Synthetic discrepancy <= 1.1 times median real-reference discrepancy, with absolute tolerance 1e-8. A heuristic screen, not a calibrated scientific acceptance guarantee.

contract.diversity: Median pairwise Euclidean distance in training-standardized pooled-image/log1p-count features; compare to equal-sized held-out samples; ratio screen 0.9..1.1.
contract.nearest_neighbor_overlap: Nearest distances to a fixed training subset; near threshold is its leave-one-out 1st percentile. Report synthetic and held-out rates, plus exact duplicate rates against the same training subset. No privacy guarantee.
contract.real_test_macro_f1: Real-only vs real+synthetic fixed C=1 logistic regression on training-fitted pooled-image features. Validation mode computes a validation proxy; only final mode computes test scores. Include class-matched real-resampling augmentation control.
contract.per_class_recall: Recall on the same held-out observations with fixed training-class vocabulary; paired, class-stratified bootstrap for macro-F1 differences.
contract.heldout_representation_quality: Frozen unconditional VAE posterior means vs training-fitted PCA at the same latent dimension; training-standardized embeddings with identical logistic probes and held-out labels. Unlabeled data are explicitly unsupported for this utility test.
contract.decision_rules: Evidence policy v2: invalid output do_not_use; pilots, validation and incomplete evidence insufficient_evidence. No conjunction of quality thresholds establishes usability. Frozen converged task comparison with positive paired interval (and positive comparison against resampling for augmentation) supports task-scoped limited_use; a negative interval supports task-scoped do_not_use. Otherwise insufficient_evidence. No absolute F1 improvement threshold. Generation without a measured downstream task cannot establish biological usefulness.
contract.image_assessment: Supplementary joint empirical energy distances in training-standardized local-gradient mean/std and training-only pixel PCA (up to 32 components); reference draws and conditional bootstrap intervals, without cutoffs. Fixed-seed per-class real/generated visual packets record source indices and explicit review status. Not FID or a validated histology score.
contract.utility_gate: Legacy descriptive flag only, not the recommendation gate: Macro-F1 improvement >=0.01, paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0, and no class recall loss >0.02; all arms converged. Representation compares VAE to PCA.

flow_evaluation_contract.domain: Continuous log(count + fixed per-cell Uniform[1e-6,1) jitter), on a training-selected gene panel. Not raw integer counts or normalized expression.
flow_evaluation_contract.fidelity: Training-standardized mean marginal Wasserstein distance and correlation MAE on up to 64 training-variable genes; compare equal-size independently dequantized real references using existing 1.1x heuristic.
flow_evaluation_contract.diversity_overlap: Same distance-ratio and training-reference overlap diagnostics in standardized continuous log-expression coordinates. No exact-zero/count-validity claims.
flow_evaluation_contract.utility: No supervised utility for this unconditional generation objective. No biological or privacy guarantee.
